Se guarda sola en settings.json y se apl: Saved automatically to settings.json and applied instantly in every window.
¿Volver toda la configuración a los valo: Reset all settings to their defaults? Your custom themes are deleted too.

¿Borrar el tema \"{name}\"? No se puede: Delete the theme "{name}"? This can't be undone (unless you import it again).
Con «Según Windows» cambia solo cuando W: With "Follow Windows" it switches by itself when Windows goes from light to dark.
Elegir el tema del modo: Choose the theme for each mode
Acepta esquemas de Windows Terminal (o s: Accepts Windows Terminal schemes (or its whole settings.json), iTerm2 .itermcolors files and xterm.js themes.
Los temas de fábrica no se editan: «Dupl: Built-in themes can't be edited: "Duplicate to edit" makes your own copy.
Une => != === en un solo símbolo. Solo e: Joins => != === into a single symbol. Only in fonts that include them: Cascadia Code, Fira Code, JetBrains Mono (not Cascadia Mono).
Mica toma el tono del fondo de pantalla;: Mica takes on the tint of your wallpaper; Acrylic shows what's behind, blurred. They only show if the background isn't opaque.
Por debajo de 100 % se ve el efecto (o e: Below 100% the effect shows through (or the desktop, if there's no effect).
Se guarda una copia en %APPDATA%\\AlphaT: A copy is saved in %APPDATA%\AlphaTerm\fondos, so it keeps working if you move the original.
Used for new tabs and windows.
Por pestaña. Más líneas, más memoria (un: Per tab. More lines, more memory (about 10,000 lines ≈ 5–10 MB).
En cmd y PowerShell: carpetas para cd, h: In cmd and PowerShell: folders for cd, history, options and common values (ping, git, npm…). Tab inserts, ↓ picks, Esc closes; ↑ is still history.
Ctrl+Espacio lo abre siempre (en PowerSh: Ctrl+Space always opens it (in PowerShell it replaces the built-in completion menu).
Le pregunta a la propia sesión (cmdlets,: Asks the session itself (cmdlets, parameters, modules). If an answer takes longer than 300 ms, that tab only asks on Ctrl+Space.
Para el nombre de la pestaña cuando la s: For the tab name when the shell has no integration. Paused while the window is minimized.
Deja que los agentes manejen AlphaTerm:: Lets agents drive AlphaTerm: see tabs, open tabs, panes and windows, run commands and read their output, and manage Docker. It only listens on 127.0.0.1 and requires a token that changes on every start.
Claude Code lanzado desde el panel de ag: Claude Code launched from the Agents panel already has it (as an MCP server). Any agent can use the CLI: node $env:ALPHATERM_CTL list
Esos dos agregan AlphaTerm a la configur: Both add AlphaTerm to the agent's global config: they're copied for you to paste yourself (nothing is changed automatically).
Antes de que un agente borre o modifique: Before an agent deletes or modifies files, it asks (in a window on top of everything) and waits for your answer.
Windows no deja frenar escrituras de cua: Windows doesn't allow stopping writes from just any program without a driver: the Guardian steps in where it can.
Claude Code lanzado desde AlphaTerm (hoo: Claude Code launched from AlphaTerm (hook before every edit, write or deleting command)
Codex lanzado desde AlphaTerm (con su mo: Codex launched from AlphaTerm (with its approval mode: -s read-only -a on-request)
Siempre: comandos que un agente manda po: Always: commands an agent sends through the control API (run, send, docker rm). Other agents (agy, OpenCode…) can't be stopped from outside.
Muestra lo que cambian los agentes en lo: Shows what agents change in files (text, code, and PDFs by their text), also outside git, with what was added and removed. You can edit and save from there.
Claude Code lanzado desde AlphaTerm (hoo: Claude Code launched from AlphaTerm (hook before and after every edit: exact)
La carpeta de cualquier pestaña con un a: The folder of any tab with an agent running (copied at start and compared)
De la copia de la carpeta quedan afuera: The folder copy leaves out what git ignores, hidden folders, node_modules and target, and files over 2 MB; for those it compares against the last commit or shows the whole file. The user folder and drive roots aren't watched.
Opcional: cada cierto tiempo se le pasan: Optional: every so often the last lines of active tabs are sent to a model (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio…) and its answer becomes the tab name. A title set by a program (Claude Code) and a name set by hand still take priority.
Por ejemplo qwen2.5:1.5b en Ollama. Uno: For example qwen2.5:1.5b in Ollama. A small one is enough.
Ventanas, pestañas, paneles con su carpe: Windows, tabs, panes with their folder, colors, tab groups and title.
Claude Code con --continue y Codex con r: Claude Code with --continue and Codex with resume --last (they pick up the last conversation in that folder). Otherwise they're left as shells in their folder.
Esto cambia la statusline de Claude Code: This replaces Claude Code's statusline (~/.claude/settings.json) with AlphaTerm's, which saves the 5-hour and weekly limits for the footer.
Antes se guarda una copia del archivo (s: A copy of the file is saved first (settings.json.antes-de-alphaterm). Continue?
Listo. Copia del archivo anterior en {ba: Done. Copy of the previous file at {backup}. It shows up on Claude Code's next reply.
Como el System dashboard: al abrir Alpha: Like the System dashboard: when AlphaTerm opens and every few minutes, each agent is opened hidden (no window) and asked for its usage: claude /usage, codex /status and agy /quota. You don't need to have used them and it doesn't spend quota. Claude takes about 10 s.
Sesión de 5 h, semana, semana por modelo: 5-hour session, week, week per model, extra usage, plan and model (live check). Between checks, Claude Code's statusline updates it while you use it.
Claude Code no tiene statusline configur: Claude Code has no statusline set.
Límites de 5 h y semanal, plan y modelo: 5-hour and weekly limits, plan and model (live check). Between checks, what Codex leaves in its sessions while you use it.
Dato oficial de agy /quota por grupo de: Official agy /quota data per model group (doesn't spend quota). It runs with its updater off: otherwise a cmd window flashed for an instant.
Releer los archivos de Claude y Codex ca: Reread Claude and Codex files every
En la barra de pestañas; clic para ver l: In the tab bar; click to see processes and what each tab uses.
{combo} también lo usa «{command}»: gana: {combo} is also used by "{command}": the first one in the list wins. Change one of them.
Se interceptan antes de que la tecla lle: They're caught before the key reaches the shell. Ctrl+Alt can't be used: on Spanish keyboards it's AltGr (to type @, # or [).
(antes NovaTerm): terminal para trabajar: (formerly NovaTerm): a terminal for working with AI agents. Tauri 2 + Rust, SolidJS and xterm.js.
frena a Claude Code (hooks) y a Codex (s: stops Claude Code (hooks) and Codex (its approval mode) launched from AlphaTerm, and anything that goes through the API. It can't stop just any program: Windows doesn't allow it without a file system driver.
al abrir AlphaTerm y cada tantos minutos: when AlphaTerm opens and every few minutes, each agent is asked, opened hidden (claude /usage, codex /status, agy /quota), like the System dashboard. No credentials are read and their servers aren't called. Between checks, Claude Code's statusline and Codex's sessions keep it updated.
de Claude Code lanzado desde AlphaTerm s: for Claude Code launched from AlphaTerm it knows exactly what changed; for other agents, it compares against a copy of the folder taken at start (without what git ignores or files over 2 MB).
PowerShell, Git Bash y cmd. WSL no, y en: PowerShell, Git Bash and cmd. Not WSL, and in cmd the exit code isn't known.
El .itermcolors no tiene colores de fond: The .itermcolors file has no background and text colors

Barra de pestañas arriba / a la izquierd: Tab bar on top / on the left

Ir a la pestaña N / a la última: Go to tab N / to the last one
Ctrl+Alt es AltGr en el teclado español:: Ctrl+Alt is AltGr on Spanish keyboards: it's used to type @, # or [
Necesita Ctrl o Alt (si no, se come tecl: Needs Ctrl or Alt (otherwise it swallows keys you type)
